profile.personalityDescription: Optimistic, enthusiastic, collaborative. You repeatedly chose to bring people with you and keep the team energised.

narrative.feedback:
Your Leadership Profile: The Energiser

Your dominant colour is YELLOW — Collaborative. You consistently chose to bring people with you. Your decisions favoured open dialogue, shared ownership and the morale of the team, even when a faster unilateral call was available. This was driven by your two most-used styles: democratic (29%) and authoritative (26%). Your signature strengths are you built buy-in before you acted, you kept the team energised through setbacks, and you made it safe for people to raise ideas. The edge to watch is avoiding the hard, unpopular call, and letting consensus delay a decision that was yours to make. For example, in year-end reckoning you leaned on democratic leadership — one of the moments that shaped the profile above.

Self-Image vs Reality:

✅ Aligned. You told us you lead with Democratic — and your decisions bore that out, using it 29% of the time, more than any other style. Your self-perception and your behaviour are telling the same story, which is the foundation of coachable leadership.

What You Did Well:

You achieved exceptional growth (28.0%) while maintaining team performance. Your team morale remained strong, demonstrating that you brought people with you. You showed genuine agility, particularly in adapting your approach when faced with challenges.

Your LEAD Competencies Explained:

Leadership (43%): Adequate - Limited style variety suggests some over-reliance on comfort zone.

Excellence (27%): Needs development - 0 info requests indicates decisions made on instinct rather than evidence.

Agility (30%): Needs development - Difficulty adapting to uncertainty or changing contexts.

Determination (24%): Needs development - Insufficient drive for results or resilience under pressure.

Decision-Making Rigor:

⚠️ You requested zero additional information across all 9 scenarios. This "decide on instinct" approach is fast but dangerous - you are operating with incomplete data. You succeeded despite this, but will not always be lucky. Evidence-based leaders outperform gut-decision makers over time.

Your Leadership Personality (Jung Model):

Your dominant color is YELLOW: Optimistic, enthusiastic, collaborative. You repeatedly chose to bring people with you and keep the team energised.

Typical YELLOW strengths: High Leadership (collaborative), High Agility (adaptable), energizing teams. Watch out for: Lower Determination (conflict avoidance), scattered focus. ✅ This matches your profile - great people skills but could be more results-focused when needed.

The Key Insight:

You demonstrated balanced leadership, adapting your style to context while keeping both results and people in focus. This is sustainable high performance.

This was driven by your two most-used styles: coaching (40%) and authoritative (18%). Leadership (51%): Adequate - Limited style variety suggests some over-reliance on comfort zone.

Excellence (56%): Adequate - Only 9 info requests suggests some reliance on gut-feel decision making.

Agility (48%): Adequate - Struggled somewhat with ambiguous situations or changing priorities.

Determination (32%): Needs development - Insufficient drive for results or resilience under pressure.

Where You Left Performance on the Table:

You achieved 27.9% when 30%+ was possible with more strategic choices.

Your dominant color is BALANCED: The Adaptive Leader - You repeatedly chose the approach the moment demanded rather than one fixed style.
